syncs.description: Sync leads (unqualified prospects) from Microsoft Dataverse, incrementally by versionnumber, with a periodic full refresh to detect deletions.
syncs.name: leads

id.description: Unique identifier of the lead (Dataverse leadid GUID). Example: "7ba18ae0-4d0e-ea11-a813-000d3a1bbd52"

subject.description: Topic or title summarizing the lead. Example: "5 Cafe Grande Espresso Machines for A. Datum"

firstname.description: First name of the lead contact. Example: "Gabriela"

lastname.description: Last name of the lead contact. Example: "Christiansen"

fullname.description: Full display name of the lead contact. Example: "Gabriela Christiansen"

salutation.description: Salutation of the lead contact. Example: "Ms."

emailaddress1.description: Primary email address of the lead. Example: "gabriela@adatum.com"

telephone1.description: Primary business phone number of the lead. Example: "930-555-0168"

mobilephone.description: Mobile phone number of the lead. Example: "930-555-0169"

companyname.description: Company or organization the lead belongs to. Example: "A. Datum Corporation"

jobtitle.description: Job title of the lead contact. Example: "Purchasing Manager"

websiteurl.description: Website URL associated with the lead. Example: "http://www.adatum.com/"

address1_line1.description: First line of the primary address. Example: "2345 Birchwood Dr"

address1_city.description: City of the primary address. Example: "Redmond"

address1_stateorprovince.description: State or province of the primary address. Example: "Washington"

address1_postalcode.description: Postal code of the primary address. Example: "98101"

address1_country.description: Country or region of the primary address. Example: "United States"

statecode.description: State of the lead: 0 = Open, 1 = Qualified, 2 = Disqualified. Example: 0

statuscode.description: Detailed status reason of the lead, interpreted relative to statecode. Example: 1

leadsourcecode.description: Source of the lead as a Dataverse option set value (e.g. 1 = Advertisement, 3 = Web, 8 = Trade Show). Example: 7

leadqualitycode.description: Quality rating of the lead: 1 = Hot, 2 = Warm, 3 = Cold. Example: 2

estimatedvalue.description: Estimated value of the potential deal. Example: 15000

estimatedamount.description: Estimated revenue amount of the lead in the transaction currency. Example: 25000

estimatedclosedate.description: Estimated close date of the potential deal as an ISO 8601 timestamp. Example: "2026-12-31T00:00:00Z"

revenue.description: Annual revenue of the lead company. Example: 25000000

numberofemployees.description: Number of employees at the lead company. Example: 160

description.description: Free-text description or notes about the lead

donotemail.description: Whether the lead has opted out of email communication. Example: false

donotphone.description: Whether the lead has opted out of phone communication. Example: false

ownerid.description: GUID of the user or team that owns the lead (Dataverse ownerid lookup). Example: "1dbc2dba-9bb2-f111-aaac-000d3a3bd5b5"

parentaccountid.description: GUID of the account this lead is linked to (Dataverse parentaccountid lookup). Example: "83883308-7ad5-ea11-a813-000d3a33f3b4"

parentcontactid.description: GUID of the contact this lead is linked to (Dataverse parentcontactid lookup). Example: "8da18ae0-4d0e-ea11-a813-000d3a1bbd52"

campaignid.description: GUID of the campaign that sourced this lead (Dataverse campaignid lookup). Example: "3fa18ae0-4d0e-ea11-a813-000d3a1bbd52"

createdon.description: Timestamp when the lead was created, ISO 8601 UTC. Example: "2026-09-18T19:43:07Z"

modifiedon.description: Timestamp when the lead was last modified, ISO 8601 UTC. Example: "2026-09-18T19:45:23Z"

syncs.description: Sync notes (annotations) from Microsoft Dataverse, incrementally by versionnumber, with a periodic delete-tracked full refresh.

id.description: Unique identifier of the note (Dataverse annotationid GUID), e.g. "0b536c4c-2bbc-f111-aaad-7ced8d717fa5".

subject.description: Subject line of the note.

filename.description: File name of the document attached to the note, when the note has an attachment.

mimetype.description: MIME type of the attached document, e.g. "text/plain", when the note has an attachment.

filesize.description: Size in bytes of the attached document; 0 when the note has no attachment.

isdocument.description: Whether the note has an attached document.

object_id.description: GUID of the parent record this note is attached to, e.g. an account or contact id.

object_type.description: Logical name of the parent record entity this note is attached to, e.g. "account".

owner_id.description: GUID of the user or team that owns the note (systemuser or team id).

created_by.description: GUID of the user who created the note.

modified_by.description: GUID of the user who last modified the note.

createdon.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the note was created, e.g. "2026-09-29T17:29:26Z".

modifiedon.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the note was last modified. The incremental sync cursor is the Dataverse versionnumber, not this field.

Note.description: A Dataverse note (annotation), optionally attached to a parent record such as an account, contact, or opportunity.

syncs.description: Sync sales opportunities from Microsoft Dataverse, incrementally by versionnumber with a periodic full refresh to detect deletions.
syncs.name: opportunities

id.description: Unique identifier of the opportunity (Dataverse opportunityid GUID). Example: e90a0493-e8f0-ea11-a815-000d3a1b14a2

name.description: Subject or title of the opportunity.

description.description: Free-text description of the opportunity.

emailaddress.description: Primary contact email address stored on the opportunity.

estimatedvalue.description: Estimated revenue of the opportunity in the transaction currency.

estimatedclosedate.description: Estimated close date as an ISO 8601 date. Example: 2026-10-23

actualvalue.description: Actual revenue of the opportunity in the transaction currency, set when the opportunity is closed.

actualclosedate.description: Actual close date as an ISO 8601 date; omitted while the opportunity is still open.

closeprobability.description: Probability of closing the opportunity as an integer between 0 and 100.

stepname.description: Display name of the current stage in the sales process. Example: 1-Qualify

statecode.description: State of the opportunity: 0 = Open, 1 = Won, 2 = Lost.

statuscode.description: Status reason option set value paired with statecode.

createdon.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the opportunity record was created. Example: 2026-09-18T19:43:18Z

modifiedon.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the opportunity record was last modified. The incremental sync cursor is the Dataverse versionnumber, not this field. Example: 2026-09-18T19:44:35Z

_customerid_value.description: GUID of the customer (account or contact) associated with the opportunity.

_parentaccountid_value.description: GUID of the parent account for the opportunity.

_parentcontactid_value.description: GUID of the parent contact for the opportunity.

_ownerid_value.description: GUID of the user or team that owns the opportunity.

_transactioncurrencyid_value.description: GUID of the transaction currency record used for money fields.

syncs.description: Sync Microsoft Dataverse phone call activities, incrementally by `versionnumber`, with a periodic full crawl to detect deletions.

id.description: Unique identifier of the phone call activity (Dataverse `activityid` GUID). Example: "1d1d5314-ed24-eb11-a814-000d3a30f257"

subject.description: Short summary of the phone call. Example: "Intro call with Kenya"

description.description: Detailed notes for the phone call.

phonenumber.description: Phone number dialed, in free-text form. Example: "930-555-0168"

directioncode.description: Direction of the call: true = outgoing, false = incoming.

statecode.description: State of the phone call: 0 = Open, 1 = Completed, 2 = Canceled, 3 = Scheduled.

statuscode.description: Detailed status reason of the phone call (e.g. 1 = Open, 2 = Made, 3 = Received, 4 = Canceled).

prioritycode.description: Priority of the phone call: 0 = Low, 1 = Normal, 2 = High.

scheduledstart.description: Scheduled start time of the call (ISO 8601 UTC). Example: "2026-09-16T03:30:00Z"

scheduledend.description: Scheduled end time of the call (ISO 8601 UTC).

actualstart.description: Actual start time of the call (ISO 8601 UTC).

actualend.description: Actual end time of the call (ISO 8601 UTC).

actualdurationminutes.description: Actual duration of the call in minutes. Example: 6

regardingobjectid.description: GUID of the parent record this call is regarding (e.g. an account, contact, lead, or opportunity).

ownerid.description: GUID of the user or team that owns the phone call.

createdby.description: GUID of the user who created the phone call record.

modifiedby.description: GUID of the user who last modified the phone call record.

createdon.description: Timestamp when the record was created (ISO 8601 UTC). Example: "2026-09-18T19:43:40Z"

modifiedon.description: Timestamp when the record was last modified (ISO 8601 UTC). The incremental sync cursor is the Dataverse versionnumber, not this field.

PhoneCall.description: A Microsoft Dataverse phone call activity.

syncs.description: Sync task activities from Microsoft Dataverse, incrementally on `versionnumber`, with a periodic full refresh to detect deletions.
syncs.name: tasks

id.description: Unique identifier of the task record (the Dataverse `activityid` GUID). Example: "f6f57339-4687-eb11-a812-000d3a09c1c0"

subject.description: Subject or short title of the task.

description.description: Full description or body text of the task.

scheduledstart.description: Scheduled start time of the task as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

scheduledend.description: Scheduled end (due) time of the task as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

actualdurationminutes.description: Actual duration of the task in minutes.

prioritycode.description: Priority of the task as a Dataverse option-set value (0 = Low, 1 = Normal, 2 = High).

statecode.description: State of the task as a Dataverse option-set value (0 = Open, 1 = Completed, 2 = Canceled).

statuscode.description: Detailed status of the task as a Dataverse option-set value, tied to `statecode`.

ownerid.description: GUID of the user or team that owns the task (from the `_ownerid_value` lookup).

regardingobjectid.description: GUID of the parent record this task is regarding, e.g. an account or contact (from the `_regardingobjectid_value` lookup).

createdon.description: Timestamp the task was created, as an ISO 8601 UTC string.

modifiedon.description: Timestamp the task was last modified, as an ISO 8601 UTC string. The incremental sync cursor is the Dataverse versionnumber, not this field.

Task.description: A task activity in Microsoft Dataverse (the OData v4 data platform underlying Dynamics 365 CRM).

syncs.description: Sync Microsoft Dataverse teams incrementally by versionnumber, with a periodic full refresh to detect deletions.
syncs.name: teams

id.description: Unique identifier of the team (Dataverse teamid GUID). Example: "5e3835b4-9bb2-f111-aaac-000d3a3bd5b5".

name.description: Display name of the team. Example: "org98374485".

description.description: Free-text description of the team.

teamtype.description: Team type option-set value: 0 = Owner, 1 = Access, 2 = Microsoft Entra security group, 3 = Microsoft Entra Office group.

isdefault.description: Whether the team is the default team of its business unit.

businessunitid.description: GUID of the business unit the team belongs to.

administratorid.description: GUID of the systemuser who administers the team.

createdon.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the team was created. Example: "2026-09-17T13:28:51Z".

modifiedon.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the team was last modified. The incremental sync cursor is the Dataverse versionnumber, not this field. Example: "2026-09-17T13:28:57Z".

Team.description: A Microsoft Dataverse team (entity set: teams).

syncs.description: Incrementally sync Microsoft Dataverse system users (systemusers), with a weekly full refresh to detect hard-deleted users.
syncs.name: users

id.description: Unique identifier of the system user (the systemuserid GUID), e.g. "6c3b2c4f-1234-4f5a-8b9c-0d1e2f3a4b5c".

fullname.description: Full display name of the user, e.g. "Ada Lovelace". Omitted when null upstream.

firstname.description: First name of the user. Omitted when null upstream.

lastname.description: Last name of the user. Omitted when null upstream.

internalemailaddress.description: Primary internal email address of the user, e.g. "ada@fabrikam.com". Omitted when null upstream.

domainname.description: Sign-in name of the user (domain\username or UPN). Omitted when null upstream.

title.description: Job title of the user, e.g. "Sales Manager". Omitted when null upstream.

applicationid.description: Entra ID application (client) ID when this identity is an application user. Omitted for interactive users.

isdisabled.description: Whether the user account is disabled. Dataverse typically disables users instead of hard-deleting them.

islicensed.description: Whether the user is licensed in the tenant.

createdon.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when the user record was created, e.g. "2026-09-29T15:49:54Z".

modifiedon.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when the user record was last modified. The incremental sync cursor is the Dataverse versionnumber, not this field.

User.description: A Microsoft Dataverse system user (systemuser entity). Users are rarely hard-deleted; they are typically disabled via isdisabled instead.
